functions.description: Batch rename of directly-mapped attributes with no further logic

event.action lowercased; event.outcome derived from event.code (0 success, 1 unknown/partial - not folded into success, other failure); event.duration seconds to ns; unmapped attributes to custom namespace
Event time from event.end (completed jobs only) into _time, not @timestamp (platform constraint); unset while running
Emit only DONE job transitions to the detection index; sample roughly 1-in-10 in-flight (QUEUED/ACTIVE/REQUEUED) states per recommendations.direct.cribl
Set event.dataset (no hyphen, platform constraint) and drop the now-redundant JSON:API envelope remnants
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
